Physical terminal permutation must be validated before executable binding.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Rating-critical limits and physical binding remain unresolved. Resolution: The archived PJ-102A sheet (03/11/2025) has the exact physical binding: p2 schematic 1 = center pin, 2 = sleeve, 3 = spring contact normally closed to 2 (opens on insertion), and the Recommended PCB Layout top view labels 1#, 2#, 3#. Correction: on p1 the 2.5 A 'rated input current' is printed in the MAX column, not typ (the existing current_rated_typical row mislabels it); 24 Vdc 'rated input voltage' is in the typ column and is the only voltage rating; contact resistance 30 mOhm max. A plug-inserted contact model (center and sleeve paths, pin 3 open) closes the binding. Voltage closure requires accepting the rated 24 Vdc as the working ceiling (never relabelled an absolute max); reviewer decision required, and the original conservative 16 V envelope can stay as the checker limit if preferred.
